title: This Mammal Glides 150 Meters and It Isn't a Bat or a Squirrel

scenes.text: This animal glides 150 meters, and it isn't a bat.
It's a colugo, and despite the nickname flying lemur, it isn't a lemur.
A skin cloak stretches from its neck to its fingers, toes and tail.
It glides about 70 meters between trees, losing very little height.
It can even make a 180 degree turn in mid-air.
On a trunk it only hops slowly. In the air, 150 meters.

description:
This animal glides 150 meters, and it isn't a bat.
Colugos stretch a skin membrane from neck to tail, glide about 70 meters between trees and up to 150 meters at most, and can turn 180 degrees mid-glide.
Which animal would you be if you could glide? Comment below.
first_comment: Clumsy climber, expert glider. Which animal is your favorite weird flyer?
